channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Oct 30
item.description:
89 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Fixed harbors not spawning any crates in Tier 2 (including custom maps).
  • Turn‑in‑place now respects the parent yaw, correcting rotation behavior.
  • Switched seagull group population to a convar‑controlled system and added the population to procedural generation registers.
  • Quick‑craft actions are now focusable and usable when navigating with the D‑pad.
  • Fixed gamepad UI drag‑threshold, making menu navigation smoother for controller players.

World & Resources

  • Fixed harbors not spawning any crates in Tier 2 (including custom maps).

Player Controls

  • Turn‑in‑place now respects the parent yaw, correcting rotation behavior.

Mounts & Vehicles

  • Adjusted horse canter control for smoother handling.

Wildlife

  • Switched seagull group population to a convar‑controlled system and added the population to procedural generation registers.

UI & Crafting

  • Quick‑craft actions are now focusable and usable when navigating with the D‑pad.

Inventory & Store

  • Fixed a NullReferenceException that could occur in the limited store grid, preventing crashes and UI errors when accessing the store.

World & Environment

  • Adjusted world generation order to keep caves above power line layouts, eliminating floating powerlines over caves.
  • Improved erosion system with per‑biome soil removal and new splat map, delivering more realistic terrain shaping.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Fixed gamepad UI drag‑threshold, making menu navigation smoother for controller players.
  • Corrected store UI formatting, ensuring item listings display properly.
  • Resolved missing 'NEW' badge on store items when new skins are released, so players see fresh content notifications.
  • Fixed overlapping icons and emoji offsets in the pie menu, improving clarity of quick‑access selections.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Map movement now behaves consistently at any zoom level, making navigation smoother.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Oct 29
item.description:
77 development commits

Base Building

  • Fixed full‑height walls where the bottom face could incorrectly connect to the top face of a neighboring wall.
  • Added a full voxel‑based visibility flood for each base to correctly detect missing sockets and incorrect block connections.

Weapons & Combat

  • Disabled research and crafting for the UZI 9mm, removing it from the tech tree.
  • Fixed a sight‑mod bug where ADS values were overridden when the stock was collapsed.
  • Corrected night‑vision goggle sound restarting when gesturing.
  • Fixed mortar ammo indicator not updating correctly.

User Interface

  • Fixed the loadouts UI delete confirmation popup being uninteractive.

Map & Environment

  • Prevented monument placement where terrain blend maps overlap river topology, stopping floating water glitches.
  • Various swarm fixes: corrected crab and jellyfish job behavior and made rare blue crab color tints more noticeable.

World Interaction & NPC

  • Fixed beacon repairable collider so it no longer blocks ladders, preventing players from climbing near beacons.
  • Fixed crow flock error, restoring proper crow behavior.

Wildlife & World

  • Server admins can now force gull groups to startle or land via console commands, and gulls no longer clip through obstacles.
  • Bird interest zones can be placed in monuments to attract flocks; corpses briefly draw crows, and explosions cause birds to flee the area.
  • Seagull groups have been added to the livestock scene, increasing wildlife activity there.
  • Bird hit detection bounds have been increased, keeping birds within hit‑registration range and reducing missed shots.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Oct 28
item.description:
99 development commits

Base Building & Construction

  • Storage containers no longer require authorization when unlocked in softcore mode.
  • Angled walls now correctly select the adjacent half‑height wall, fixing placement glitches.

Vehicles

  • AI‑controlled boats that flip now auto‑right themselves and keep passengers aboard.
  • Rowboat turning prediction corrected; aiming now matches actual yaw.

NPC & AI

  • Scientist‑spawned boats are removed when the scientist dies, preventing abandoned vessels.

Combat & Weapons

  • Weapon handling improvements: aiming while holding another item, melee head wobble while jogging, and Uzi stock deployment/holster behavior fixed.

World Interaction

  • Radiation water sprinklers now start with the correct color and no brief clear‑water flash.
  • Doors no longer get stuck half‑open after alt‑tabbing; dynamic occlusion pausing re‑enabled.
  • Scarecrow null reference error resolved, restoring its functionality for base defense.

Gameplay Systems

  • Recessive gene names are now shown explicitly in the UI and vendor, clarifying genetics.
  • UGC upload limits raised to 1,000 per queue and server IP/port now included in request body after API changes.
  • Event schedule now saves remaining hours on server restart, preventing full cooldown resets (e.g., cargo ship spawn).
